blocks.tamil_translation: Hazrat Abu Darda (RA) narrates, I heard the Prophet ﷺ say, “Whoever walks on any path to learn the knowledge of the Deen, Allah causes him to walk on one of the paths of Jannah. Learning the knowledge of the Deen becomes a means of entering Jannah. The angels spread their wings to please the seeker of the knowledge of the Deen. All creatures in the heavens and the earth, and the fish in the water, make Du'a for the forgiveness of the one who has knowledge. Just as the full moon of the fourteenth night has superiority over the stars, the one who has knowledge certainly has superiority over the worshipper (Abid). Certainly the learned are the heirs of the Prophets; the Prophets did not leave dinars and dirhams (wealth and riches) as inheritance. Rather, they left only knowledge and wisdom as inheritance. Therefore, whoever acquires the Ilm of the Deen has taken a full share (of the inheritance).”

blocks.arabic_text: عَنْ أَبِي الدَّرْدَاءِ ﵁ قَالَ: سَمِعْتُ رَسُولَ اللهِ ﷺ يَقُولُ: وَمَوْتُهُ (أَيِ الْعَالِمِ۞) مُصِيبَةٌ لَا تُجْبَرُ وَثُلْمَةٌ لَا تُسَدُّ وَهُوَ نَجْمٌ طُمِسَ مَوْتُ قَبِيلَةٍ أَيْسَرُ مِنْ مَوْتِ عَالِمٍ.
blocks.source_reference_arabic: (وهو بعض الحديث) رواه البيهقي في شعب الايمان:٢ /٢٦٤
blocks.tamil_translation: Hazrat Abu Darda (RA) narrates that Rasulullah ﷺ said, “The death of an Alim is a loss that cannot be made good, a gap that cannot be filled; through his death he becomes a star that has lost its light. The death of an entire tribe is far lighter than the death of a single Alim!”

blocks.arabic_text: عَنْ أَنَسِ بْنِ مَالِكٍ ﵁ قَالَ: قَالَ النَّبِيُّ ﷺ: إِنَّ مَثَلَ الْعُلَمَاءِ كَمَثَلِ النُّجُومِ فِي السَّمَاءِ يُهْتَدَي بِهَا فيِ ظُلُمَاتِ الْبَرِّ وَالْبَحْرِ فَإِذَا
